pr_body:
# ↪️ Pull Request

This PR fixes some more issues that were discovered while trying to run Parcel globally on a project that has custom Babel configuration. One issue was the instance of `@babel/core` used to create the babel config was a different than the instance that ran transform. In the monorepo, they ended up being the same version, so we didn't catch it in our tests. There was also a case where we needed to use `localRequire` over `require`. Last thing was that the reload case was broken. I've added tests cases for running Parcel globally both with the default Babel config and with custom Babel config, as well as the reload case.
pr_comments: This seems to fix #3503, is that a "coincidence" or does it make sense?
@mischnic Yes, this should resolve that issue.
